mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 62 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School under a waning gibbous moon, with an overnight low of 40 degrees and no rain in the forecast.

City updates include the start of winter parking regulations on November 20 where you must park on specific sides of the street, and a reminder that the Senior Center will be closed on November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving.
There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, and Hop Haus trivia all happening today, followed by Main Street Trick-Or-Treating and music at Bailey's Run tomorrow.
In police news, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I offence during the early morning hours of October 25.
Today is the perfect day for some OREO REESE'S Cheesecake, and since the shop is open until 10:00 PM tonight, you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
